info.name: SmartParking - SPARK-238 Facility Structure (manual verification)
info.description:
# SPARK-238 Facility Structure - manual end-to-end verification

Exercises every FacilityService structure route authored for SPARK-238. Route paths, request records and response fields are taken from `src/Services/FacilityService/SmartParking.FacilityService.API/Program.cs` (source of truth).

## Folders

- **00 Setup (run first)** - login each role, generate `runSuffix`.
- **01 Lot** - `POST /api/parking-lots`, `GET /api/parking-lots` (inactive lots stay listed), rejected legacy whole-structure ingest.
- **02 Units** - `POST /{id}/units` FLOOR to ZONE to BLOCK plus duplicate-sibling 409.
- **03 Slots** - `POST /{id}/slots` single and multi vehicle types, live duplicate 409, released-code 409 `IDENTIFIER_RELEASED`.
- **04 Paths** - `POST /{id}/paths`.
- **05 Structure PATCH** - every action in `PATCH /{id}/structure` and the `configureSlot` geometry rejection.
- **06 Reads** - `GET /{id}/structure`, `GET /{id}/operational-layout`, `GET /{id}/operator-layout`.
- **07 Maintenance windows** - list/create/extend/cancel and the overlap 409.
- **08 Batch** - `POST /{id}/structure/batch` idempotency header, all-or-nothing and per-item failures.
- **09 Operations** - `POST /{id}/operations` and `GET /{id}/operations/{operationId}` replay.
- **10 Negative / Auth** - missing bearer 401, foreign tenant 403, foreign lot 404, operator-layout gating.

## Run order

Run folders top to bottom. Folder 00 must run first: it stores every token and the run suffix. Do not reorder folder 03 before folder 02.

## Default local ports

- UserService: `http://localhost:5035` (`userServiceUrl`)
- Reservation/OperationService: `http://localhost:5055` (`reservationServiceUrl`)
- FacilityService: `http://localhost:5045` (`baseUrl`)

`GET /{id}/operator-layout` also needs the demo seed (`scripts/seed-demo-site.ps1`) so the operator is assigned to `seededSiteId` with `SLOT_OVERRIDE`.

## Data-dependent cases

- `GET /{id}/operator-layout` (6.4) needs the seeded demo site.
- PATCH `backup` / `markBackup` need the Owner to hold `BACKUP_CONFIGURE` / `BACKUP_MARK` (the demo Owner does).
- The maintenance-window reopen guard (7.11) only fires once another window covers `now`; the script logs an explicit SKIP and the guide explains how to observe the 409.

## Evidence note

No application is started by this task. These artifacts were checked statically against `Program.cs`; every path and field used here exists in that source. Where API-design v1.3 disagrees with the code, the code is followed and the discrepancy is recorded in `SPARK-238-manual-test-guide.md` section 5.

item.name: 05 - Structure PATCH actions
item.description: Every PATCH /api/parking-lots/{id}/structure action SPARK-238 defines, plus the configureSlot geometry rejection. Each successful action returns 200 {success:true}.

body.raw:
{
  "action": "profile",
  "code": "SP238-P-{{runSuffix}}",
  "name": "SPARK-238 Test Lot A renamed",
  "address": "2 Facility Road",
  "latitude": 10.78,
  "longitude": 106.71,
  "tenantId": null
}

request.description: Action `profile` updates code (upper-cased), name, address and the paired coordinates (code 1-50, name 1-255, address 1-2000, lat/lon in range and paired).
Action `active` toggles lifecycle status only. Sending true keeps the lot ACTIVE for the remaining folders (the INACTIVE proof is done on the disposable lot in 1.4/1.5).
Action `renameUnit`. Rejects a case-insensitive duplicate among live siblings; the new name is distinct.
Action `capacity` sets a layout limit (0 = no limit). The disposable unit has no slots, so 5 is accepted.
Action `removeUnit` soft-deletes an empty unit (no children, slots or paths). A non-empty unit would return 409 UNIT_NOT_EMPTY instead.
Action `restoreUnit`. Reuses the row id and is refused if a live sibling now holds the name.
Action `removeSlot`. Soft delete, allowed only while the site has no live commitment and the slot is not occupied/protected/backup-marked.
Action `restoreSlot`. Idempotent and keeps the row id, so allocation/audit history stays attached.
Action `moveSlot` moves the slot to the ZONE and renames its code. The target unit must be live and the new code unique, and the slot must not be occupied/protected.
Action `configureSlot` with server-owned geometry left null. A9/F13: non-null coordinates3D or features is rejected (5.11/5.12).

A9 / F13: slot geometry is owned by the fixed 3D template and may not be written by the Owner. ParkingStructure.ConfigureSlot requires coordinates3D is null, otherwise 400 INVALID_STRUCTURE. The value only needs to be non-null; the domain does not parse coordinates3D as JSON.

F13/DE-17: features is server-owned in this contract, so any non-null value is refused with 400 INVALID_STRUCTURE. EditStructure is not annotated with JsonUnmappedMemberHandling.Disallow, so the field binds and is then rejected by the domain.
Action `removePath` soft-deletes an access path. A missing path would return 400 PATH_NOT_FOUND in the current middleware mapping.
Action `restorePath`. Both endpoints must still be live; the floor and zone remain registered.

Action `backup` configures a site-level CAR backup policy (unitId empty = site scope, capacity = count). Requires BACKUP_CONFIGURE; the demo Owner holds it. If the Owner lacked it the endpoint returns 403 FORBIDDEN before applying the edit.

Action `markBackup` sets the slot reservation state to BACKUP (the `active` boolean is the mark flag). BACKUP_MARK must be explicitly granted to the account (DEC-LOT-04) and is not inherited from site ownership. The demo Owner does not hold BACKUP_MARK, so the request is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN before any edit is applied.

Action `markBackup` with active:false releases the BACKUP designation. Releasing it also requires the explicit BACKUP_MARK grant (DEC-LOT-04), which the demo Owner does not hold, so the request is rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN and the slot is left unchanged.
StructureEditHandler.Apply throws INVALID_STRUCTURE for an unrecognized action, mapped to 400.

A second site-wide window whose [start,end) overlaps window 1. The same-database exclusion constraint (ex_maintenance_windows_site_overlap) rejects it; the store maps it to 409 STRUCTURE_IN_USE. Nothing is cancelled or moved.
Window 2 starts after window 1 ends, so it does not overlap. It is the extend/cancel target. Stores `maintenanceWindow2Id`.

exec: pm.test('the new end is later than before', () => {

request.description: A later end is a valid extension. The store resets enforcement_state to pending because the added interval has not been acknowledged (DE-13).
Moving the start is not an extension; MaintenanceWindowRules.Extend returns STRUCTURE_IN_USE (409). Note this request sends end:null, so the require-a-new-end branch is not reached.
A window created only to be cancelled while no other window covers now. Stores `maintenanceWindow3Id`.

console.log('SKIP: expected 200 cancelling window 3 before it starts, got HTTP ' + status + '. Window 1 already covers now, so the reopen guard applies to every cancel. See guide section 3.3.');

request.description: DELETE /{id}/maintenance-windows/{windowId} (Program.cs:282-286). A window that has not started can be cancelled. If window 1 already started (run took longer than 45s), the reopen guard returns 409 instead; the script logs SKIP in that case.

item.name: 7.11 DELETE window 2 while window 1 covers now (reopen guard)

exec: pm.test('the reopen guard returns 409 or is not yet eligible (200)', () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(status));
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { body = undefined; }

console.log('SKIP: got HTTP ' + status + '. The guard only rejects a cancel while another live window covers now. Window 1 starts at ' + pm.environment.get('windowStart1') + '. Wait until that time and re-send this request to observe 409 STRUCTURE_IN_USE. See guide section 3.3.');

request.description: Reopening early must not bypass another closure. CancelAsync returns 409 STRUCTURE_IN_USE when another non-cancelled window still covers now. Because a window cannot be created with a start in the past, this is only observable once window 1 (started 45s after 7.2) is in force; re-send after that time if the first attempt logs SKIP.

item.name: 09 - Operations
item.description: POST /{id}/operations and GET /{id}/operations/{operationId}. The operation is keyed by idempotencyKey and its outcome is completed / pending / failed.

request.description: POST /{id}/operations (Program.cs:240-244). OperationBody(idempotencyKey, edit, tenantId). Only removeSlot/removeUnit/capacity/active/moveSlot/configureSlot/batch are accepted actions. The status maps to 200 completed / 202 pending / 409 failed. Requires ReservationService for the impact plan. Stores `operationId`.
GET /{id}/operations/{operationId} (Program.cs:245). A successful read does not by itself mean the operation completed; the response carries the status.

exec: pm.test('replay returns the original operation id', () => pm.expect(body.data.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('operationId')));

request.description: The identical idempotencyKey and edit replay the stored operation, never a second record (A8).
The store throws SITE_NOT_FOUND for an operation id that is not in the caller's scope, mapped to 404 by the middleware.

item.name: 10 - Negative / Auth
item.description: Auth boundaries: missing bearer 401, a tenant outside the caller scope 403, a foreign or missing lot 404, and the operator-layout SLOT_OVERRIDE gate.

item.name: 10.1 GET lot list without bearer (401 UNAUTHENTICATED)

request.description: No Authorization header. OwnerIdentityClient throws UNAUTHENTICATED before any outbound call; the middleware maps it to 401.
A write route with no bearer is rejected before the structure is loaded.
The owner structure read requires a bearer session; no data is returned without one.

item.name: 10.4 List with a foreign tenantId (403 FORBIDDEN)

request.description: The tenantId query selects an authorized tenant and never grants one. Scope(identity, foreignTenantId) throws FORBIDDEN (Program.cs:150-156), mapped to 403.

item.name: 10.5 Structure read with a foreign tenantId (403 FORBIDDEN)

request.description: Same tenant-selection rule on the structure read.

item.name: 10.6 Create unit with a foreign tenantId (403 FORBIDDEN)

request.description: A body tenantId outside the caller scope is refused by Scope before the edit is prepared.

exec: pm.test('no data leaks about the foreign site', () => pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('data'));

request.description: A well-formed site id that the caller does not own (or that does not exist) is indistinguishable from a missing site: 404 SITE_NOT_FOUND, no existence leak (A3).
The maintenance store resolves the site with a tenant predicate first (EnsureSiteAsync) and throws SITE_NOT_FOUND for a foreign or missing site.
SlotOperatorClient rejects a missing bearer before calling UserService, mapped to 401.

item.name: 10.10 Operator-layout with a driver token (403 FORBIDDEN)

request.description: The legacy operator-layout route requires an assigned Operator with SLOT_OVERRIDE. The UserService slot-scope endpoint is operator-only, so a driver token yields 403 FORBIDDEN.
